benefits.title: Healthy Teeth & Gums
benefits.description: Neem Oil strengthens gums and protects the teeth from bleeding and infections! Say bye-bye to teeth problems!

benefits.title: Protects from Cavities
benefits.description: Aloe Vera protects the mouth from oral cavities and infections, keeping it safe and healthy.

benefits.title: Refreshes the Mouth
benefits.description: Our toothpaste is strawberry flavoured and contains no artifical chemicals, leaving a refreshing taste in the mouth.

benefits.title: Removes Plaque
benefits.description: Triphala and pomegranates provide the perfect protection for your teeth as their anti-bacterial properties remove plaque.

ingredients.name: Aloe Vera
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Aloe vera helps in keeping gum diseases, infections, and oral cavities away. It also soothes kid’s teeth.

ingredients.name: Neem Oil
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Neem Oil prevents tooth decay, oral infections, prevents bleeding and sore gums. It also prevents cavities and gum disease.

ingredients.name: Triphala
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Triphala has proven to significantly decrease plaque and boost oral hygiene.

ingredients.name: Pomegranate
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: The antibacterial qualities in the pomegranates serve to fight dental plaque. It lowers the chances of developing tooth decay and gum disease.

fullIngredientsList: Sorbitol, Silica, Glycerine, Aqua, Xylitol, Lauryl Glucoside, Dicalcium Phosphate, Flavour, Carboxy Methyl Cellulose, Stevia, Aloe Vera, Neem Oil, Triphala extracts, Pomogranate extracts.

description:
► For Ages 2-5

► Our Strawberry flavoured Toothpaste makes brushing teeth fun for your little one!

► Removes 99.9% germs & plaque.

► Improves gum health and reduces the chances of cavities.

► Leaves a refreshing taste in your child's mouth!

► Formulated with natural ingredients like aloe vera, neem oil, pomegranate and triphala.
Use a pea-sized amount of toothpaste & gently brush gums & teeth in a circular motion. Rinse, gargle & giggle.

howToUse:
Rinse, gargle & giggle

'My kid used to make such a big fuss when she had to brush their teeth in the night. But now she loves it! The strawberry taste of this toothpaste makes her love brushing her teeth and she doesn’t stop before the 2 minutes are up! It’s also very comforting for me as a parent to know that it’s natural and doesn’t contain unnecessary chemicals.'

faqs.question: How do we use the Strawberry Toothpaste?
faqs.answer: Use a pea-sized amount of toothpaste & gently brush gums & teeth in a circular motion. Rinse, gargle & giggle.

faqs.question: Is it safe for children?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our toothpaste is fluoride free and doesn't have any side effects.

faqs.question: Is it safe if my child accidenly swallows the toothpaste?
faqs.answer: Yes! It is safe if swallowed.

reviews.author: Shivali Jose
reviews.title: Best option for non-fluoride
reviews.body: I was looking for non-fluoride options for my daughters and saw this on Instagram. They have been using it now for a week and the feedback is that it tastes really good.

reviews.author: Praneesh Verma
reviews.title: Not problematic even if mistakenly ingested
reviews.body: Helps keep my baby’s breath fresh. I was having a lot of issues with him ingesting the regular toothpaste. This one is really helpful. Thank you Little Joys.

reviews.author: Sejal Shah
reviews.title: Good chemical free product
reviews.body: Cleans the teeth well and the natural ingredients give a very fresh feeling. A major factor for me preferring this over other pastes is that it is all natural.
